description_for_model: Autonomous compliance engine for the EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115). Verifies plot coordinates, satellite radar deforestation past 2020, VIES VAT numbers, and generates TRACES-NT Due Diligence Statements (DDS).
description_for_human: Automated EUDR deforestation verification, GIS polygon audits, and TRACES-NT XML filing.
